title: After 70k+ mod downloads on Nexus, I made my own game as a solo dev. The free beta of my anime volleyball game is out
author: Think-Shoulder-4960
selftext:
Just released a free beta on itch.io!

I come from the modding scene: my mods on Nexus have passed 70,000 downloads. Now I've released a free beta of my own game as a one-person studio.

Nexus Profile: [https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tyr4nTX](https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Tyr4nTX)

Build a team. Play the match. Watch them get better.

Run a Japanese university volleyball team through one full season: recruit new players, plan your training, go on café dates, and play or simulate every match. Single match is in there too if you just want to jump in.

Download: [https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/ace-of-hearts-campus-volleyball](https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/ace-of-hearts-campus-volleyball)

Windows, plus Steam Deck through Proton. Controller or mouse and keyboard. English and German. No payments, it's completely free.

I'm a one-person dev, so feedback really helps: [https://discord.gg/uazeCWycCB](https://discord.gg/uazeCWycCB)

AI disclosure: music, sound effects, voices and the opening film use generative AI. Some fanservice, no nudity. All characters and events are fictional. All characters are 21 years of age or older.
